dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters. The transition from the dark exterior coat to the light ring edge is high-contrast and sharp, while the internal centers of the rings remain dark with a subtle gradient decrease in intensity towards the geometric center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: The lateral surface shows a high spatial density of light-colored pixel clusters, primarily localized within the ring perimeters. These clusters consist of high-intensity white and grey pixels with compact cores and irregular, speckled boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank form an elongated scalene triangle. An additional cluster of smaller blobs forms a linear chain extending posteriorly from the dorsal-most vertex of this triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive interlocking pattern resembling a distorted figure-eight is visible on the posterior lateral flank, composed of two partially fused light-intensity rings.
